datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Madagascar in 2017. Geographic polygons were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity levels, with multiple scenarios projected for different time periods (February, June, October). Data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis of food insecurity impacts.
